title: Sectionwise image and injectivity of proper-support exchange
statement: Let a Cartesian square have horizontal projections a:Xprime->X and b:Yprime->Y and vertical maps f:X->Y and fprime:Xprime->Yprime, both separated and locally of finite type [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For a sheaf F of Lambda-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] form the proper-support sheaf of [lem-cbc-proper-support-section-calculus]. The ordinary base-change morphism b^*f_*F->fprime_*a^*F, restricted along b^*(f_!supp F)->b^*f_*F, is sectionwise injective and on each etale V over Yprime its image consists exactly of sections with support proper over V [def-cbc-etale-section-proper-support, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

proof.text: Pullback preserves proper support, giving the sectionwise map G->b_*H for the two literal support sheaves. Its adjunct beta:b^*G->H has composite with the inclusion equal to the restricted ordinary comparison.

At an algebraically closed geometric point use the proper-support geometric-stalk restriction isomorphisms on both sides. Inverse-image stalk compatibility and the Cartesian identification of the two fibres identify the map beta with the identity on properly supported sections.
Geometric stalk detection makes beta an isomorphism. Its composite with the literal support inclusion is therefore sectionwise injective with exactly the stated image.

theorem properSupportExchange_range (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (a : X' ⟶ X)
    (b : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsSeparated f'] [LocallyOfFiniteType f'] (sq : IsPullback a f' f b)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : Y'.Etale) :
    Function.Injective
      (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) b).map
          ((properSupportLowerStarInclusion Λ f).app F) ≫
        (baseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).app F).hom.app (op V)) ∧
    ∀ s, (∃ t,
      (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) b).map
          ((properSupportLowerStarInclusion Λ f).app F) ≫
        (baseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).app F).hom.app (op V)) t = s) ↔
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) a).obj F)
        (f'.Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom f') s
